pull-request-header:
Releases MedTracker 0.6.0 with the Rust/Loco application.

A fresh PostgreSQL 18 database and new accounts are required. Keep the previous Rails database separately.

See the [release notes](https://github.com/damacus/med-tracker/blob/main/docs/releases/0.6.md) for changes and known limitations, and the [installation guide](https://github.com/damacus/med-tracker/blob/main/docs/operations/loco-cutover-runbook.md) for setup.
